retake.retakeFee: Retest fee applies; see MVD fee schedule

gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 50 hours (10 at night); 75 hours (15 at night) if an approved online course is used
gdl.passengerLimits: First 6 months: no more than 1 passenger under 18; second 6 months: no more than 3 passengers under 18 (family exceptions)

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity, date of birth, and lawful presence (e.g. birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Two documents proving Montana residency (for REAL ID)
process.realIdNotes: A Montana REAL ID requires proof of identity/date of birth/lawful presence, one proof of Social Security Number, and two documents proving Montana residency. A REAL ID is marked with a star; a standard credential is also available.
process.permitFee: Age-based: $36.57 at age 14.5, decreasing by credential duration to $5.67 at age 20 (standard, no motorcycle endorsement)
process.licenseFee: $62.32 for a standard 12-year license at ages 21-63; age- and term-based fees apply outside that range

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 30 conviction points within 3 years qualifies a driver as a habitual traffic offender and triggers revocation proceedings
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane or slow down for stopped emergency, law enforcement, and other authorized vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 80 mph (rural interstate, daytime and night); lower where posted, e.g. 65 mph in urban areas
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: As posted; obey reduced school-zone limits when children are present (Montana has no single statewide school-zone number)
